description_expanded: Description Description 30A ESCAPES presents… “30A Gulf Cove,” a brand-new luxury retreat near Gulf Place on 30A. Spanning three beautifully designed levels, this 7-bedroom, 7-bath home comfortably sleeps 16 and offers plenty of space to settle in with family and friends. Spend sunny afternoons beside your private, seasonally heated pool, gather around the firepit after dinner or head out to explore with the included 6-seater LSV and 9 bikes. Inside, three separate living areas give everyone room to spread out, while the incredible chef’s kitchen makes gathering for meals just as memorable. Beautifully designed from top to bottom and completely new, “30A Gulf Cove” brings together the space, comfort and laid-back luxury made for a 30A getaway. Learn more below…👇*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Brand-New Luxury Home with three levels of beautifully designed coastal livingPrime Location near Gulf Place with the beach just a 2-minute LSV or bike ride awayPrivate Backyard Oasis with a seasonally heated pool, sun loungers, gas firepit and fenced yardSleeps 16 Comfortably with 7 bedrooms and 7 full bathroomsChef’s Dream Kitchen with luxury stainless steel appliances, premium cookware and bakeware, walk-in pantry and generous prep spaceThree Separate Living Areas giving families and groups plenty of room to gather or spread outEntertainment for the Whole Family with Live Hulu on every TV, PS5 gaming station and a vinyl record player with album collectionBeach-Ready Setup with beach chairs, wagon and cooler provided for guest useExplore Gulf Place and neighboring 30A communities with the convenience of a 6-seater LSV (Low-Speed Vehicle) and 9 included bikes.3 Washers & 3 Dryers, ideal for large groups, beach towels and extended stays*** LIVING AREAS ***With a living area on every level, “30A Gulf Cove” makes it easy for a full house to spend time together while still having plenty of room to spread out. The second floor serves as the main gathering space, while additional lounges upstairs and downstairs are perfect for movie nights, games or downtime between beach and pool days. Live Hulu is available on every TV throughout the home, making it easy to keep up with live sports, news and favorite programming during your stay.First-Floor Living Area with cozy sectional, flat-screen TV, dedicated PS5 gaming station with controllers, collection of family board games, poker set and convenient kitchenette with microwave and mini fridgeSpacious Second-Floor Living Room with ample seating, open-concept layout connecting the kitchen and dining area and a vinyl record player with album collectionThird-Floor Living Area with cozy sectional, flat-screen TV and direct access to the spacious balcony*** KITCHEN & DINING ***The second-floor kitchen is a chef’s dream and one of the standout spaces in the home. Luxury appliances, generous counter space and a walk-in pantry make it just as well suited for preparing a casual family breakfast as it is for bringing in a private chef for dinner. And for the coffee lovers, the Ninja espresso machine has your mornings covered.Spacious Chef’s Kitchen with luxury stainless steel appliances, walk-in pantry, premium cookware and bakeware, wine glasses, glassware, gold flatware and ample prep and storage spaceLarge kitchen island with bar seating for 5 plus dining table with seating for 6Ninja espresso machine for coffee, lattes, cold brew and slow mornings at homeFirst-floor kitchenette with microwave and mini fridge for added convenience*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***Seven bedrooms are thoughtfully spread across all three floors, giving larger families and groups plenty of privacy at the end of the day. Five King suites offer comfortable retreats for the adults, while two bunk rooms give younger guests their own spaces to settle in. Premium mattresses throughout the home make it easy to recharge for another day on 30A.1st FloorBunk Room: Two Twin-over-Twin bunk beds, flat-screen TV and En-suite with single vanity, walk-in shower and convenient hallway accessKing Guest Suite: King bed, flat-screen TV and En-suite with dual vanities and walk-in shower2nd FloorBunk Room: Twin-over-Twin bunk bed, flat-screen TV and En-suite with dual vanities, walk-in shower and convenient hallway accessKing Guest Suite: King bed, flat-screen TV, private balcony and En-suite with single vanity and walk-in shower3rd FloorKing Guest Suite: King bed, flat-screen TV and En-suite with dual vanities and walk-in showerKing Guest Suite: King bed, flat-screen TV and En-suite with single vanity and walk-in showerPrimary King Suite: King bed, flat-screen TV, private balcony and En-suite with dual vanities and walk-in shower*** OUTDOOR PRIVATE OASIS ***Days at “30A Gulf Cove” don’t have to end when you come home from the beach. The fully fenced backyard centers around your private pool, with plenty of space to lounge in the sun, grill dinner or challenge the family to a game of cornhole or giant 4-in-a-Row. As evening settles in, gather around the gas firepit downstairs or head up to the third-floor balcony for cocktails and the last light of the day.Private, seasonally heated pool with 4 sun loungers and plenty of room to spend the afternoon outsideBack patio with gas grill, outdoor dining for 6 and gas firepitFully Fenced Backyard with cornhole and giant 3-foot wooden 4-in-a-Row gameThird-floor balcony with outdoor sofa, coffee table and additional seating, perfect for morning coffee or evening cocktails*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY ***Located just off 30A near Gulf Place, “30A Gulf Cove” puts the beach and some of the west end’s favorite spots within easy reach. Grab one of the 9 included bikes and be at the sand in about 2 minutes. Beach chairs, a wagon and cooler are also provided at the home, making it easy to pack up and head to nearby Ed Walline Regional Beach Access for the day. When you’re ready to explore, spend an afternoon wandering Gulf Place, head to Shunk Gulley for fresh seafood and live music or hop on the 30A bike path and see where the day takes you.Beach Access just a 2-minute bike ride from the home with beach chairs, wagon and cooler provided for guest use6-Seater LSV & 9 Bikes Included for trips to the beach, Gulf Place and nearby 30A favorites.Gulf Place nearby for restaurants, boutiques, local art, coffee and seasonal eventsEd Walline Regional Beach Access nearby for an easy day on the GulfShunk Gulley Oyster Bar, Pizza by the Sea, The Perfect Pig, Amor Café, Kith + Kin Coffee and other local favorites close byScenic Highway 30A bike path nearby for exploring Dune Allen, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach and beyond*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included in our quotes. It can be purchased during the reservation process or obtained independentlyWe DO NOT accept wire transfers for paymentWaiver required to access the 9 provided bikes and 6-Seater LSV. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A Escapes3 Washers & 3 Dryers are located throughout the home for added convenience, especially for large groups and extended staysPool heating is available seasonally between September 1 and April 30There is a camera at the entry of the home*** YOUR STAY - OUR PRIORITY ***At 30A ESCAPES, we’re committed to providing a luxurious, safe and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 guest support and an immaculate home designed for comfort, connection and relaxation.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! *** Read less
